sections.name: Our Story
sections.title: A new name on a familiar corner.
sections.lead: Orchard Trail Nutrition is the new chapter of a club that has been part of the Romeo and Washington Township routine for years.
paragraphs: In August 2026 the shop changed hands — new owners Jeff and Laura took the keys, and the club was renamed Orchard Trail Nutrition. Same faces behind the counter, same shakes and teas, a fresh name over the door.

It is a simple idea, done properly: real fruit flavors, blends made when you order, and a room where the regulars know each other. This fall the club also joined the Northern Macomb Regional Chamber of Commerce — a small business, firmly rooted in the neighbourhood it serves.

sections.kitsTitle: Mega tea kits, packed to go.
sections.kitsNote: Each kit holds the collagen, tea, energy and custom flavors for one 42 oz mega tea — just add ice. Seasonal kits rotate monthly and sell out, so call ahead if one is for you.
sections.footNote: Prices are posted in store and vary by size and flavor — the only price published online is the $1 sparkling-soda add-on. Everyday drinks come from a MENU highlight saved about 85 weeks ago and nutrition figures are OTN’s own macro sheet, so confirm today’s list in store.
